limits: 128/512 batch-one comparisons use only 2 warmup and 4 updates; the profiled update is excluded from throughput.
Final batch-eight synthetic throughput uses 20 warmup and 100 measured updates; it excludes data loading, evaluation and checkpoint I/O.
Actual-mixture comparisons use only 2 updates; the final rerun uses a different physical RTX 3090, identified by device label.
Real-mixture data and initialization require reconstruction; only metadata and curves are distributed here.
Batched BF16 reductions are not bitwise identical to scalar kernels; this audit does not establish learning-curve equivalence.
Sparse-phase native curriculum, full media resolutions and production resource qualification remain separate gates.
Current RecordDataset revalidates and reencodes native records; large-scale encoded data indexing and startup cost need qualification.
